'''Callahan Intrastate Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Interconnect with Cypress Pipeline, western Nassau County, Florida to Interconnect with Peninsula Pipeline, Nassau County, Florida.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Peninsula Pipeline Co; SeaCoast Gas Transmission LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''26 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''16 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2018<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19745/000162828021003104/cpk-20201231.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
